payload.text: Make an info-based website for me. The website is for b2b coffee bean sales. It should emphasise trust, confidence. I want people to get info and contact me at last for any coffee query

**Defining the Scope**

I'm now focusing on defining the scope for a B2B coffee bean sales website. The core aim is to project trust and professionalism to drive contact inquiries. I'm exploring React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for the frontend, with Gemini API suggested, but I'll clarify how to include it for information delivery and query handling, as it is implied but not explicitly stated.


**Refining Content and Features**

I'm now zeroing in on the website content and key features. I'm thinking of building in a dynamic "Coffee Expert AI" chatbot, perhaps utilizing Gemini for content creation to give it a dynamic feel. I'm focusing the Hero section with impactful imagery and a clear value proposition, along with establishing trust indicators through detailed sourcing information and certifications. The product catalog will include types of beans and roast levels. I'm also planning to highlight quality control and confidence-building information. The Contact Form remains the ultimate objective.


**Detailing Design & Tech**

I'm now outlining the design system. I've chosen deep browns, creams, slate grays, and gold accents. Serif fonts will be used for headings and Sans-serifs for the body. I'm focusing on clean layouts, plenty of whitespace, and placeholder images to drive a premium feel. I'm planning out the tech implementation, starting with metadata and index files. I'm focusing on React components and the routing. Finally, I've planned out service layers to incorporate the Gemini API for a chat bot, probably via `gemini-3-flash`.


**Incorporating AI Features**

I'm now detailing the chatbot's system instructions, defining my persona as a B2B coffee consultant. I'll use "preview" for fast text responses in the chatbot. I'm focusing on "Ethically Sourced," and "Lab Tested" for Trust & Confidence, with a minimalist visual style. I'm building it as a floating widget or a "Consultation" section. The Gemini service will require `generateContent`. I've realized an e-commerce cart is unnecessary; a "Quote Request" cart or simple contact form is sufficient to meet requirements.


**Refining the AI Section**

I'm now iterating on the AI consultant feature. I've decided to rename the chatbot to "Digital Consultant" to align with a more B2B professional image. I've re-conceptualized the app structure, including the AI consultant as its own section. Mentally drafting the code, I have the `geminiService.ts` file, `App.tsx` coordinating sections, and `ChatSection.tsx` handling the UI. After reviewing the requirements, I'm confirming React 18+, TypeScript, and Tailwind are all suitable, with the Gemini API for the "query" component.
